messages:
harper: quick log from this morning's RAG-onboard + speculative decode run on 13B-int4. seeing weird truncation when retrieval snippets end with ellipses (...) or citation brackets.
noah: can you paste a minimal repro? also which int4 scheme (gptq, awq)?
harper: AWQ per-layer static scales, outlier clamp on attention. repro prompt: "Given the doc excerpts, summarize action items. [DOC_SNIPPET: ...]" output often ends right after the bracket with <EOS>. about 3.2% of retrieval-augmented requests.
tess: hmm retrieval boundary tokens + quant noise could create an accidental high EOS logit. speculative accepts based on stage1 confidence might be fooled. what's speculative config?
harper: speculative size=5, accept_thresh=0.7, second-stage re-eval allowed. sampler top-k=50 temp=0.6.
oah: do you see difference if you strip trailing punctuation from snippets?
harper: yes. when we strip trailing ellipses/brackets the failure drops to 0.4%. so boundary token is correlated.
evalbot: run 3480011300 summary: sample=20k RAG calls, p50 latency=64ms, p95=210ms, spec_accept=24%, truncation_rate=0.032. artifacts: s3://evals/3480011300/rag-spec-traces.tar.gz
tess: could be tokenizer id remapping after AWQ. if the snippet contains rare subtokens that map differently in quantized int4 tables we might get shifted logits. try re-tokenizing with deployment vocab and diff ids.
harper: did that: token ids identical for >99.9% tokens, but the rare outliers (citations like [1]) changed mapping in trimmed vocab.
oah: propose three-prong mitigation: 1) soft-policy: for RAG responses, increase accept_thresh to 0.85 for models with int4/awq, 2) surgical: add post-retrieval snippet sanitize to strip trailing ellipses/brackets before passing to LM, 3) long-term: re-run AWQ with per-token calibration for rare tokens.
tess: add to that: for short outputs (<30 tokens) require stage2 delta > 0.4 for EOS accept. avoids single-token spikes.
harper: quick ABed (1+2): truncation drops to 0.005, p95 latency +12ms. quality (ROUGE-L on labeled set) unchanged within noise.
evalbot: labeled set: 600 RAG prompts. baseline FP16 truncation=0.002, int4->spec baseline=0.032, int4->spec+sanitize+thresh=0.006. detailed diffs: s3://evals/3480011300/diffs.csv
oah: rollout plan suggestion: gate speculative for RAG until we validate 25k samples with sanitize on. keep speculative enabled for non-RAG traffic.
harper: implement canary: variant=13b-int4-rag-sanitize, sample=25k, speculative=off-for-rag, spec-accept-thresh=0.85 for other routes. starting now.
deploybot: canary launched 3480011350: variant=13b-int4-rag-sanitize sample=25000 ETA=3h. will post when complete.
tess: also tracking long-term AWQ retrain ticket: ML-INV-5293 for per-token calibration and trimmed-vocab-aware quant. assigning to noah.
harper: I'll collect token-level traces and a small manual review set (200). tagging in PR with quick repro and trace link.
evalbot: note: automated alert rule created: if truncation_rate > 0.01 on RAG traffic for any quant build -> page oncall. rule id: alert_trunc_rag_2026.
oah: nice. when can we flip speculative back on for RAG? after canary completes and labeled recall/precision > 0.98?
tess: yep. add a hard safety net: if observed stage2_delta_mean_for_EOS < 0.2 then auto-disable speculative for that build.
harper: thanks team. will update thread when deploybot posts results. :white_check_mark:
